trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap stages in order and let this be the last thing that unlocks. The list has no online and no DLC trophies, so one single-player save can earn everything.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Unmissable. While you are in this chapter, take the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' when it appears — guides report it is the key that opens bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A main-path set piece: play it through and the trophy is yours. It is also good practice for the free-roam robberies later in the roadmap — the escape habits you learn here feed Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Main-path and unmissable. Remember the airport layout — you will come back here in free roam for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main-path and unmissable; it unlocks as the operation concludes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats, and both big launch guides rank this the hardest trophy in the game — though its thresholds are forgiving: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of everything there is to do. Most lines fill in while you earn the other trophies, so leave it for last and use the checklist to target what remains. One warning from GTABase and TechWiser: using cheats disables trophies and saving, so keep a trophy run cheat-free.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunt events spread over Leonida — stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps — so you only need about two-thirds of them, and under-bridge flights are reported as the fastest kind to farm. Note the 100% checklist asks for 300, so if A Long Road is the goal, keep going after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win anything. Most types unlock across the first chapters, so sweep this up early; several other trophies (Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler, Fair Game) each cover one type on the way.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each weapon class has its own set of challenges at the ranges, and gold is a score target rather than a win, so replay a challenge until the score lands — accuracy streaks matter more than speed. Clearing all 42 also covers the shooting range's full share of the 100% checklist.

sources.label: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. PowerPyx counts 42 individual races across 14 drone-race locations, but the trophy only asks for one win at each location — pick the shortest race at each spot. Take a sighting lap first if the course is tight; a clean run beats a fast crash.

sources.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List (reporting GTABase & PowerPyx)
Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of a race you have already won do not add to the count, so keep travelling to fresh race markers instead of grinding one easy circuit. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, so carry on past 20 if you are chasing A Long Road.

sources.label: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at his fishing spot, accept the challenge and land the better catch before the timer runs out. Fishing is also one of the nine activity types Master of None needs, so this visit does double duty.

sources.label: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Vice City; pick the shortest game on offer and play it through to the end screen rather than quitting out early. It also ticks off the video-game activity for Master of None.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand: work through every job Andy gives you until his chain ends. One report (TechWiser) warns that stranger chains can have windows tied to story progress, so start Andy's chain when it first appears on the map instead of saving all the strands for the endgame. This chain also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. As with the other named strangers, follow his markers through the whole chain rather than stopping after the first job, and begin the chain when it unlocks — one report links stranger-chain availability to story progress. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Run Billy's chain to its last job; starting it as soon as it appears is the safe play, since one report says stranger chains can close as the story advances. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is one stranger's whole chain of missions, not a single job — a strand only counts when you finish its final mission. The five named-character chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) each carry their own trophy and all count toward these eight, so do those first and then finish any three more strands.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Follow Randy's chain to the end, and start it when it unlocks rather than banking it for later — one report ties stranger-chain windows to story progress. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Work Tyrone's jobs through to the finale of his chain, beginning when the strand first opens to be safe against the story-linked windows one report warns about. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy launch guides flag. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida: 18 spots per GTABase (the 100% checklist counts 15). The risk is the first session: Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and that spot is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends. Whether it is strictly required is unconfirmed, but both GTABase and PowerPyx say to do it — so meditate on the balcony before you finish Chapter 1, then sweep the remaining spots in free roam.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting request and track down the one-of-a-kind animal he sends you after; which animal it is was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so follow Bret's markers and clues rather than a map pin. The hunt also covers the hunting activity type for Master of None.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game (per GameMapa); the trophy only needs any three finished, though the 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so completionists should keep collecting. Cards turn up in shops, bars and landmarks all over Leonida — pick up every one you pass while working on other trophies and the sets complete themselves.

Build the habit of scanning whenever a point-of-interest prompt appears — the same scans discover vehicles for Whip It Good. The 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans, so nothing here is wasted effort.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game (per GameMapa), so you can leave the 30 hardest untouched. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so if A Long Road is the end goal, treat 70 as the real target and pick off the quick challenges first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Cause trouble together until you reach 4 stars — a bank-vault robbery is a reliable way to get there — then break the police line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain. Guides point to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a dependable hiding spot. Your partner must be with you when the level is lost, so do not split up during the escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The chain breaks if your stars fully drain between shops, so keep the heat alive: the jewelry stores of North Vice City sit close together, which makes them the natural route. If the trophy has not popped after the third shop, GTABase's advice is to rob a fourth before the wanted level lapses.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. You do not need to drive them: GTABase confirms a WAiNK scan is enough to discover a vehicle. Stand by a busy road and scan the traffic flowing past — this fills in surprisingly fast, and every scan session also moves You WAiNKer! along.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill the Focus meter completely before you start, carry an assault rifle, and trigger Focus in the middle of a group of gang members — guides report that cops, soldiers and civilians do not count toward the five. Gang operations and robbery escapes give you the densest crowds of valid targets.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. GTABase's method: steal a docked passenger jet from the airport and fly roughly a kilometre away. Expect a wanted level for the theft — lose it afterwards, or simply enjoy the flight first.

trophies.guide: The description is a hint, not an explanation: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' GTABase's read is to steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The air station is military ground, so go in ready for heavy resistance and get the tank out before it is disabled.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The quiet route guides describe: slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code inside, and empty the safe without anyone spotting you. If you are seen, walk away and try another night rather than shooting your way out — detection is what voids the trophy, not the robbery itself.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults only open up after the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — follow a security van into a bank while its vault stands open, which is why this trophy sits in the Chapter 4 stage of the roadmap. Expect a 4-star response and have a fast bike waiting outside for the escape. The 100% checklist counts 8 vaults, so plan on three more after the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run regular routes around the state: block one in, deal with its guards, take the cash from the back, then lose the wanted level. One clean truck is all the trophy asks for.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the map fog from all 52 areas of the state. Normal play reveals most of it; for what is left, guides say flying over the remaining dark patches is the quickest method, so finish with a plane or helicopter sweep of the whole state.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Leonida has 9 gangs (per GTABase), and you need one robbed operation per gang — not nine robberies anywhere. Use this tracker to note which gangs you have already hit; the map's gang territories tell you whose turf an operation sits on.

It costs almost nothing to try whenever you are on the beachfront, and it is one of five hidden trophies the guides had not fully solved at launch.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The steps were unconfirmed at launch; GTABase's theory is the obvious one — get into a car inside a dealership showroom and drive it out through the showroom window rather than the door. Pick a car already parked inside so the exit is pure glass.

trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Head to the alley and bowl a full game: the wording points at finishing properly, so play through to the final frame instead of quitting mid-game. The precise trigger was still being pinned down in launch-week guides, but a complete game at that specific alley is the requirement as published.

trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' GTABase's reading of this cryptic one: max out the Strength stat for both partners, Jason and Lucia. Melee fighting and brawling raise Strength, so swap between the two characters and grind both to the cap — a natural side effect of the robbery and gang trophies if you fight hand-to-hand on the way.

trophies.guide: 'Choices made (for better or worse).' PlayStation tracks this one to 500: perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (GTABase). Robberies, escapes and gang hits all move the profile, so it fills in on its own across a platinum run — check the counter late in the game rather than farming it early. Note GTABase also reports one profile outcome (Irredeemable) is permanent, so it is worth knowing what your actions are doing to the profile.

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm.' Still unsolved in launch-week guides (PowerPyx: not yet known). The description points at failing something once and then succeeding on the retry — a race, a challenge or a robbery. If it has not popped naturally by the endgame, deliberately fail an activity and immediately complete it on the second attempt.

sources.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List (reporting GTABase & PowerPyx)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' Unconfirmed at launch: GTABase links it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — this series has a long tradition of weird encounters, from UFOs to ghosts. Explore odd map markers and remote spots, especially at night; when something genuinely strange happens, this is the trophy that should answer it.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock a pedestrian down by swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a hit from the driver's seat, not a shot. Ride slowly past a group on a bike or in a car and swing as you pass; the trophy should pop on the knockdown. Exact steps were still listed as unconfirmed in launch guides, so experiment with speed and vehicle if the first passes do not register.

GTABase notes one fence pays better than the others, and the total builds quickly during the bank-vault and robbery grind for the 100% checklist.

Expect it to pop on its own; if it somehow has not, one Vice City shopping spree finishes it.
